body.text: CROSS-DOMAIN VALUE/COMPUTE LOOP. Use real completed household artifacts as stress, not a synthetic billing demo. Select one current housing result (prefer the completed housing-concession-arbitrage if its work/evidence remains canonical) and one current food result (prefer the completed bounded FoodCombinationGraph replay or a live direct-deal result). For each, traverse originating WorkOccurrence -> provider/model realizations -> observed UsageOccurrences/attempts -> economic measures/cost allocations where evidenced -> produced household artifact/evidence. Separately retain the domain value signal (e.g. verified quote/concession economics, basket/meal economics) without equating that value with model cost. Derive at least usage-per-accepted-result and, ONLY where provider pricing is actually evidenced, compute-cost-to-domain-value. If provider price is unknown, cash ROI remains UNKNOWN while token/resource intensity may still be measured. Expose both through the native semantic shell and prove the shell reaches the same canonical usage/allocation objects as finance. Then let a later routing/proof epoch consume the result as evidence for realization choice, never as authority. The goal is a physical closed loop: real work changes household state; that state plus execution receipts changes usage/economics; that evidence can influence future realization selection under constraints.

subject: Cross-domain value loop: household outcomes feed usage/economics and routing evidence
